sentences.chinese: 我的手机被小偷偷走了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī bèi xiǎotōu tōu zǒu le.
sentences.translation: My phone was stolen by a thief.
sentences.usage: Used to describe an object being taken unlawfully.

sentences.chinese: 这份报告被老师批改了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fēn bàogào bèi lǎoshī pīgǎi le.
sentences.translation: This report was corrected by the teacher.
sentences.usage: Indicates an action done to an object by someone.

sentences.chinese: 我被邻居养的狗吵醒了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bèi línjū yǎng de gǒu chǎo xǐng le.
sentences.translation: I was woken up by my neighbor's dog.
sentences.usage: Describes an unintended effect caused by someone else.

sentences.pinyin: Nà běn shū bèi nòng diū le.
sentences.usage: Used when the agent is irrelevant or unknown.

sentences.translation: He was criticized by the boss.
sentences.usage: Describes an action done by someone in authority.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de zhàopiàn bèi tóngxué cháo xiào le.
sentences.translation: My photo was mocked by classmates.
sentences.usage: Indicates mockery or ridicule directed at something.
